svg.title: odds wheel · bit · needle-babel
svg.text: needle: cut on the dashed line, pierce the dot, pin it through a wheel's centre

g.text: set the needle here on each wheel, then read the word
Same address, different weighting, different word.
People's words turned the path here.

svg.text: A sector's width is its probability. Landing the needle on a sector of width p takes log₂(1/p) bits of precision,
which is exactly the word's price. To land on “bit”:
with the stream: 36% of the wheel · 1.5 bits
with the model alone: 0.9% of the wheel · 6.9 bits
in Babel: 1 slice of 262,145 · 18.0 bits, a slice 0.0014° wide
Every word gets an equal slice. Drawn here: one line per degree. The real slices are 728 times thinner,
finer than any printer or hand: no needle can find a word here. The weighting is what makes a word findable.
